newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oil loadings halted at Statfjord, Gullfaks fields.
newsitem.headline: Oil loadings halted at Statfjord, Gullfaks fields.

text.p: Crude loadings at the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks developments were halted on Wednesday because of high seas, but both fields were running at full production, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said.
"There are no loading at present at Statfjord and Gullfaks because of the high waves," Statoil spokeswoman Nina Steihaug said.
Crude loadings at offshore buoys are often disrupted during the winter months because of bad weather. Tankers cannot load when waves run higher than about four metres.

"There is full production but Statfjord's storage tanks will be 90 percent full at midnight, after which we would have to reduce production there," she said. "But we are hoping to resume loadings at Statfjord around midnight because the weather outlook is improving."
Steihaug said there was no immediate danger of curbing output at Gullfaks, which she said had more loading space than Statfjord.
